evidence: frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts (truncated at start of directory upload function: "export async function uploa...")

missing_requirements.requirement: When project.collectionLocked is true, disable the Generate action/control and keep it disabled until unlock; prevent regeneration via any path and show a clear toast/message if attempted.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows a guard in the generation handler that blocks generation and shows a toast when locked, but it does not show the Generate button/control actually being disabled in the UI when locked (required by AC for click/keyboard prevention at the control level).
evidence: frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx (handleGenerate checks isLocked and toasts, but no button disabled state is shown in the provided excerpt)
